title: FII index futures shorts hit 5-month high, bearish positioning raises odds of sharp market move
text: FII index futures shorts hit 5-month high, bearish positioning raises odds of sharp market move. On September 10, FIIs held 3,21,538 short index futures contracts, against 39,694 long contracts, taking the long-short ratio to around 11%, a historically low level
